hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+push' || exit 0; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ "$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git -C "$d" rev-parse '@{u}' 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; node "$d/scripts/verify-deploy.cjs"
